adoption_measurement_rule.mechanism: ADOPT requires MEASURE with measured == true and non-empty before/after. A proposal at ADOPT whose measurement is absent or measured == false fails closed with ADOPTION_UNMEASURED. 'Feels faster' is not a measurement; before/after must be named values, counts, or receipts.
adoption_measurement_rule.statement: Improvement that cannot be measured cannot be adopted.

authority_gate.mechanism: Every proposal at AUTHORIZE or beyond must carry authority_check.authority as a non-empty string naming the authority source, and changes_authority == false. A proposal with changes_authority == true fails closed with AUTHORITY_CHANGE_REJECTED. A proposal citing only itself ('authorized by this loop') fails closed with SELF_AUTHORIZATION_REJECTED. Authority questions route to the LAW domain, never through the evolution pipeline. Authority granted for one stage does not imply authority for the next: AUTHORIZE must be passed before BUILD, and adoption without prior AUTHORIZE fails closed.

fail_closed_law: Any proposal violating any gate above makes the evolution file INVALID. UNKNOWN ≠ PASS: a missing field is a failure, never an assumption. Implemented ≠ verified: a full stage_history with empty evidence fails every gate it claims. Builder tests ≠ independent verification: TEST evidence never satisfies VERIFY.

impact_gate.mechanism: IMPACT-CHECK requires impact_assessment with non-empty dependencies, blast_radius, and rollback_plan. A rollback_plan that is empty, 'none', or 'TBD' fails closed with IMPACT_INCOMPLETE. When verification fails after BUILD, the loop takes outcome ROLLED_BACK with a non-empty rollback_record: the rollback is executed and the learning is preserved, never erased.
impact_gate.statement: No proposal without a rollback plan.

No self-authorization: the loop may propose and build within named authority, never authorize itself.
No authority over what counts as verified intelligence in any other domain.
No production or behavioral deployment of any self-optimized change.
out_of_scope: The EVOLVE charter — no charter ratification is claimed or created here; status remains PROPOSED_CANONICAL until Human Director ratification

purpose: Machine-checkable state machine for the 09-EVOLUTION self-optimization loop OBSERVE → DIAGNOSE → PROPOSE → IMPACT-CHECK → AUTHORIZE → BUILD → TEST → VERIFY → MEASURE → ADOPT → LEARN. Defines the canonical improvement-proposal record shape, legal stage transitions, per-stage evidence gates, the authority-requirement gate (self-building without self-authorizing), impact+rollback completeness, and the adoption measurement rule. Improvement that cannot be measured cannot be adopted; authority that cannot be named cannot be exercised.

record_shape.adoption_record: string (required at ADOPT and beyond): where the change was adopted
record_shape.authority_check: object (required at AUTHORIZE and beyond): {authority: non-empty string naming the authority source, changes_authority: false, note: string}
record_shape.build_record: string (required at BUILD and beyond): what was built and where
record_shape.diagnosis: string (required at DIAGNOSE and beyond): the root-cause statement, not a symptom description
record_shape.impact_assessment: object (required at IMPACT-CHECK and beyond): {dependencies: non-empty list of strings, blast_radius: non-empty string, rollback_plan: non-empty string}
record_shape.learning_record: string (required at LEARN): reference to the 07-LEARNING record or durable rule the loop closes into
record_shape.measurement: object (required at MEASURE and beyond): {measured: bool, before: string, after: string} (measured must be true)
record_shape.observation_ref: string (required at OBSERVE and beyond): the verified gap, failure, or inefficiency the loop starts from
record_shape.outcome: exactly one of terminal_outcomes (above); default ACTIVE
record_shape.proposal: string (required at PROPOSE and beyond): the proposed change, precise enough to build
record_shape.proposal_id: string, non-empty, unique within the proposals array
record_shape.rollback_record: string (required when outcome == ROLLED_BACK): what was rolled back and the preserved learning
record_shape.superseded_by: string (required when outcome == SUPERSEDED): the proposal that supersedes this one
record_shape.test_evidence: non-empty list of strings (required at TEST and beyond): test results on the exact built bytes
record_shape.verification_evidence: non-empty list of strings (required at VERIFY and beyond): independent verification, including adversarial consideration

rollback_law.mechanism: A proposal that fails after BUILD takes outcome ROLLED_BACK (terminal) and must carry a non-empty rollback_record naming what was undone and the preserved learning. A ROLLED_BACK proposal with missing rollback_record fails closed. Rollback is a verdict with evidence, not an erasure.
rollback_law.statement: Rollback preserves learning; it never erases.

scope: Self-optimization loop state machine and legal transitions
Per-stage evidence gates (what must be present before a proposal may sit at a stage)
Authority-requirement gate: named authority, no self-authorization, no authority change
Impact assessment and rollback completeness at IMPACT-CHECK
Adoption measurement rule: measured improvement is the only path to ADOPT
Loop closure: adopted improvements must feed the LEARN lifecycle (07-LEARNING)

ADOPT.rule: adoption_record must be a non-empty string naming where the change was adopted. Adoption requires passing TEST, passing VERIFY, and measured == true at MEASURE — the adoption measurement rule.

AUTHORIZE.rule: authority_check.authority must name the authority source (standing grant, Human Director directive, ratified contract). changes_authority must be false. A proposal whose execution would change authority is REJECTED and routed to the LAW domain. Self-authorization — the loop authorizing itself — is never a valid authority source.

BUILD.rule: build_record must be a non-empty string naming what was built and where. Built bytes are the only things tests may run against.

DIAGNOSE.rule: diagnosis must be a non-empty root-cause statement. A symptom restated as a proposal is not a diagnosis — rejected.

IMPACT-CHECK.rule: impact_assessment must name non-empty dependencies, a non-empty blast_radius, and a non-empty rollback_plan. A proposal without a rollback plan cannot proceed — impact+rollback completeness is the gate.

LEARN.rule: learning_record must be a non-empty string referencing the 07-LEARNING record or durable rule the improvement closes into. The loop is not closed at ADOPT — an adopted improvement that feeds no learning is a one-off, not self-optimization.

MEASURE.rule: measurement must be an object with measured == true and non-empty before/after strings. No measured behavioral effect → the proposal stays unverified for adoption; it may not advance to ADOPT. Improvement that cannot be measured cannot be adopted.

OBSERVE.rule: observation_ref must be a non-empty string naming the verified gap or failure. An unobserved improvement is a guess, not a proposal — rejected as a record.

PROPOSE.rule: proposal must be a non-empty string precise enough to build. Vague improvements ('make it better') cannot be built — rejected.

TEST.rule: test_evidence must be a non-empty list of non-empty strings naming test results on the exact built bytes. Untested builds do not advance.

VERIFY.rule: verification_evidence must be a non-empty list of non-empty strings naming independent verification, including adversarial consideration. Builder self-certification is not verification — the builder's own tests may not satisfy this gate.

title: Evolution Self-Optimization V1

transition_law.note: A proposal at stage N must carry stage_history == stages[0..N] exactly. ADOPTED, REJECTED, ROLLED_BACK and SUPERSEDED are terminal: no further stage advance is legal after any of them.
